functional_unit.definition: One kilogram of dry-equivalent textile input delivered through a declared wash, rinse and optional dry process, accepted only when cleaning, rinse residue, textile gentleness and final-moisture requirements for its textile family are met.
acceptance_conditions: cleaning performance meets the frozen acceptance floor
rinse residue meets the frozen acceptance floor
textile gentleness and fabric-damage limits are met
final moisture is within the declared endpoint range when drying is required

control_policy.sample_size_policy: Set the number of physical units and repeated cycles after the control-only pilot estimates variance, meter uncertainty, within-unit correlation and the minimum effect of interest. Three model families is a desk-comparison floor, not a statistically adequate sample-size claim.

metrics.denominator: 100 standardized accepted washer cycles at the declared capacity/programme
metrics.method: IEC 60456:2024-compatible, calibrated power measurement over frozen load and programme; report measured useful cleaning and rinse output alongside energy.
metrics.target_hypothesis: First target <=18 kWh/100 cycles versus the 20 kWh/100 desk reference; stretch <=16 kWh/100 cycles.
hard_guardrails: Cleaning, rinse and fabric-gentleness acceptance must pass.
Do not compare different programmes or label methods as like-for-like.

metrics.denominator: one accepted standardized washer cycle
metrics.method: Calibrated inlet flow measurement with water temperature and hardness recorded; include all fill, rinse and refresh stages.
metrics.target_hypothesis: First target <=45 L/cycle versus the 50 L desk reference; stretch <=42.5 L/cycle.
hard_guardrails: Cleaning and rinse quality must remain within frozen limits.
No hidden reduction in rinsing or accepted load mass.

metrics.denominator: accepted textile test load and declared stain set
metrics.method: Use the applicable IEC 60456:2024 cleaning-performance method and frozen reference textiles, detergents and analysis.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior to the best matched control across the preregistered stain set; margins set before candidate tests.
hard_guardrails: A failed cleaning acceptance gate blocks any resource-superiority claim.
Report stain classes separately; do not average away a critical failure.

metrics.unit: LAS residual / rinse performance result per IEC method
metrics.denominator: accepted standardized textile load
metrics.method: Apply IEC 60456:2024 LAS rinse-performance method and record rinse settings, detergent, water hardness and uncertainty.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior or better than the best matched control under the frozen rinse method.
hard_guardrails: Do not trade rinse performance for lower litres or cycle energy.
Missing rinse evidence is indeterminate, not pass.

metrics.unit: IEC gentleness-of-action result plus textile-specific damage vector
metrics.denominator: declared textile family over repeated wash exposures
metrics.method: Use IEC 60456:2024 gentleness method and additional repeated-cycle tensile, mass, colour and dimensional-change measurements.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior to the best matched control initially; seek >=10% lower measured damage on selected textile families as a later hypothesis.
hard_guardrails: Do not generalize one fabric result to all garments.
Textile degradation is a hard gate, not a weighted penalty.

metrics.unit: percent moisture regain on declared basis
metrics.denominator: conditioned dry-equivalent textile load at washer exit
metrics.method: Gravimetric or validated reference moisture method immediately after spin; record textile mix, ambient conditioning and load mass.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Initial target <=50%; stretch <=45% versus 53.9% secondary-dataset reference.
hard_guardrails: No fabric damage, vibration, imbalance or safety regression.
Use same moisture basis and timing for all comparisons.

metrics.denominator: declared spin programme and installation condition
metrics.method: IEC 60704 series measurement with consistent microphone geometry, installation and load balancing.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Explore <=68 dB(A) against the 72 dB desk reference.
hard_guardrails: Noise must be measured with equivalent operating cycle and mounting.
Do not infer noise from motor speed alone.

metrics.denominator: accepted wash output
metrics.method: Gravimetric dose measurement, fixed detergent chemistry/concentration, water hardness and soil challenge.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Minimize dose while meeting cleaning and rinse floors; no numeric dose is frozen before detergent and load selection.
hard_guardrails: Do not claim detergent savings from different detergent chemistry.
Cleaning and rinse gates remain mandatory.

metrics.denominator: declared load mass and inlet moisture dried to the same final moisture endpoint
metrics.method: Calibrated true-energy measurement under IEC 61121-compatible conditions; record inlet moisture, ambient conditions and final moisture.
metrics.target_hypothesis: First target <=0.62 kWh/cycle; stretch <=0.55 versus the 0.73 kWh/cycle desk reference.
hard_guardrails: Equal inlet moisture, load and final moisture are required.
No overdrying or fabric-care regression to achieve the target.

metrics.denominator: gravimetrically measured water removed from the load
metrics.method: Pair calibrated energy measurement with before/after conditioned mass and repeatable moisture measurement.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Establish matched-control baseline; then improve energy per kg moisture removed without extending endpoint or harming textiles.
hard_guardrails: Water-removal denominator must be measured, not inferred from cycle name.
Report partial and full load separately.

metrics.denominator: declared load and final-moisture endpoint
metrics.method: Time from cycle start to accepted endpoint; report full and partial load separately under matched inlet moisture.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Explore <=180 min full-load against the 199 min manufacturer listing, with no moisture or textile-quality regression.
hard_guardrails: Same endpoint and programme class are required.
Do not omit cool-down or endpoint stabilisation if the standard includes it.

metrics.unit: percent moisture condensed/contained under declared method
metrics.denominator: water removed from the declared textile load
metrics.method: Use the standard/product-method definition and independently reconcile condensate, exhaust moisture and retained system moisture.
metrics.target_hypothesis: First target >=96%; stretch >=97% against the 94% manufacturer reference.
hard_guardrails: No unsafe condensate, leakage, corrosion or microbial contamination.
Define condensation efficiency method before comparing labels.

metrics.denominator: declared drying programme and installation condition
metrics.method: Calibrated acoustic measurement with consistent installation and programme under applicable test method.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Explore <=58 dB(A) versus the 60 dB manufacturer reference.
hard_guardrails: Noise reduction cannot be achieved by reducing airflow below safe/functional limits.
Report uncertainty and microphone placement.

metrics.unit: percent airflow or pressure-drop change from clean reference
metrics.denominator: same fan command, filter state and declared fouling exposure
metrics.method: Measure air-path pressure drop, flow, temperature and energy over repeated lint/fibre loading and cleaning events.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Keep airflow and performance degradation bounded; freeze numerical margin after baseline fouling trials.
hard_guardrails: Fire and over-temperature protections remain independent.
Do not bypass lint or heat-exchanger maintenance to preserve measured efficiency.

metrics.unit: kWh dryer electricity/kg additional water removed upstream
metrics.denominator: additional residual water removed from the same textile load by washer spin relative to the frozen control
metrics.method: Run matched and randomized spin conditions; measure washer energy and residual moisture gravimetrically, then dry each load to the same final-moisture endpoint and measure dryer electricity and elapsed time. Report paired net energy, textile gentleness, vibration, noise and imbalance.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Measure the empirical change rather than assume a conversion. An illustrative 8 kg calculation for 53.9% to 45.0% residual moisture gives 0.712 kg less water; latent-heat and illustrative COP assumptions imply 0.15–0.23 kWh electrical equivalent, not a product-saving prediction.
hard_guardrails: Subtract any added washer spin energy when reporting paired net energy.
Same load, final moisture and cleaning/rinse/fabric-care acceptance are required.
No high-spin strategy wins if vibration, noise, fabric damage or reliability regress.

metrics.denominator: accepted paired wash-to-dry output
metrics.method: Sum calibrated washer and dryer energy over the exact same textile batches that pass the full functional unit; include standby/start/retry consumption within the declared boundary.
metrics.target_hypothesis: At least 10% lower than matched control pairs first; 15% stretch after matched pair controls exist.
hard_guardrails: Washer and dryer capacity/programme must be matched to the same load.
Failed or rejected batches remain in denominators and cost accounting.

metrics.denominator: accepted output, including transfer and waiting intervals within declared boundary
metrics.method: Timestamp fill, wash, spin, transfer, dry, cool-down and rework with synchronized clocks.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Explore 10% less end-to-end elapsed time versus matched pairs without degrading acceptance.
hard_guardrails: Do not report machine cycle duration as end-to-end service time.
Report median and P90 household wait time separately.

metrics.denominator: total measured microfiber mass entering the declared capture boundary
metrics.method: Validated collection and mass-balance protocol with polymer/fibre identification, bypass, filter-retained mass, cleaning loss and residual streams.
metrics.target_hypothesis: >=70% mass capture first; >=80% stretch, informed by a 2025 study reporting 35–65% for three commercial filters.
hard_guardrails: Full mass balance required; particle counts alone are insufficient.
Pressure drop, bypass, clogging and safe disposal must be measured.

metrics.denominator: accepted output after a declared wash and optional dry sequence
metrics.method: Collect and characterize effluent, dryer lint and other output streams under a validated sampling and analytical protocol.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Reduce measured release against matched controls; freeze numeric target after method detection limits and mass balance are validated.
hard_guardrails: Do not label fibre mass as plastic without polymer identification.
Dryer lint and washing effluent both count.

metrics.unit: percent change in tensile strength, mass, colour and dimensions by textile family
metrics.denominator: declared garment/test textile after a fixed repeated wash-dry exposure
metrics.method: Repeated-cycle controlled textile testing with conditioned specimens, blinded measurement and textile-family stratification.
metrics.target_hypothesis: At least non-inferior to the best matched control; later seek >=10% lower damage on selected textiles.
hard_guardrails: Do not infer garment lifetime directly from a small repeated-cycle test.
Report each textile family and uncertainty separately.

metrics.unit: minutes and elapsed days to verified restoration
metrics.denominator: all started repair attempts for the preregistered fault curriculum
metrics.method: Use existing Symtropy repair-task and proof-carrying restoration contracts; include diagnosis, travel, part wait, failed attempts, rework and verification.
metrics.target_hypothesis: >=25% lower median and P90 time to verified restoration, preserving existing washer programme target.
hard_guardrails: Failed and abandoned attempts remain visible.
Work-order closure alone does not count as restoration.

metrics.denominator: all participants who start an approved normal-user maintenance task
metrics.method: Representative usability trial with safety boundary, task success, error, time, spills, tool needs and stop conditions.
metrics.target_hypothesis: >=90% completion for approved user tasks, preserving existing washer programme target.
hard_guardrails: Mains, heater, heavy rotating assembly and sealed refrigerant work are not user tasks.
Abandoned/safety-stop attempts remain in denominator.

metrics.denominator: documented support period from end of product placement on market
metrics.method: Audit dated manufacturer/distributor commitments, exact model compatibility, supplier independence, stock and fulfilment records.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Design ambition >=15 years documented parts/service support; local fulfilment target set after supplier mapping.
hard_guardrails: Do not confuse legal minimum with voluntary commitment.
A storefront listing is not proof of stock, fit or delivery.

metrics.unit: local currency per 1,000 kg accepted dry-equivalent textile
metrics.denominator: accepted output over a declared household use profile and lifecycle horizon
metrics.method: Use Sol-Atlas household-cost projection consuming measured purchase, tariff, water, consumable, repair, freight, downtime, replacement and end-of-life inputs.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Explore >=20% lower lifecycle cost per 1,000 kg accepted output against matched local controls.
hard_guardrails: Unknown cost components remain unknown, not zero.
Report household cash cost and wider material/resource burden separately.
